name: Cancelling a fully approved request restores the balance and HR filters work

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'flow.cancelhr@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.
Open the 'Leave Balance' page (URL /balances) and verify the 'Annual Leave' card shows '12/12'.
Open the 'New Request' page (URL /requests/create), select 'Annual Leave', set Start date to 2026-11-28 and End date to 2026-11-29, enter reason 'E2E cancelhr marker' and click 'Submit request'.
Click the 'Log out' icon button, then log in with email 'supervisor@leave-portal.test' and password 'password'.
Open the 'Supervisor Queue' page (URL /approvals/supervisor), find the row for employee 'Flow Cancel Hr' with reason 'E2E cancelhr marker', click 'Approve' and confirm in the dialog.
Click the 'Log out' icon button, then log in with email 'hr@leave-portal.test' and password 'password'.
Open the 'HR Queue' page (URL /hr/approvals), find the row for employee 'Flow Cancel Hr' with reason 'E2E cancelhr marker', click 'Approve' and confirm in the dialog.
Click the 'Log out' icon button, then log in with email 'flow.cancelhr@leave-portal.test' and password 'password'.
Open the 'Leave Balance' page (URL /balances).
The 'Annual Leave' card now shows '10/12' and '2 of 12 day(s) used this year'.
Click the 'Log out' icon button, then log in with email 'hr@leave-portal.test' and password 'password'.
Open the 'All Requests' page (URL /hr/requests), type 'Flow Cancel Hr' into the 'Employee' search box and click 'Apply filters'.
Exactly one row is shown for employee 'Flow Cancel Hr' and it displays the status 'Approved'.
Click the 'View' link for that request to open its detail page.
On the detail page click the 'Cancel request' button (top right).
The request now shows status 'Cancelled' and a message 'The request was cancelled.' is displayed.
Open the 'All Requests' page again (URL /hr/requests).
The 'Flow Cancel Hr' row now shows the status 'Cancelled'.
Click the 'Log out' icon button, then log in with email 'flow.cancelhr@leave-portal.test' and password 'password'.
Open the 'Leave Balance' page (URL /balances).
The 'Annual Leave' card shows '12/12' again, confirming the deduction was restored on cancellation.
